rule.name: SiblingValuePassed
rule.message: A value that belongs to another property fills this slot: the call sets one property from a variable named for a different one while a variable named for this property is never read, or an argument is repeated while its numbered sibling is left out. This is a copy-paste slip that compiles and shows up only at runtime. Pass the matching value (config.timeColumn(timeColumn), onException(type1, type2, type3)). An exception fits a converter that renames on purpose.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $scopeOf := function($n) { $n/ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1] }, $unread := function($scope, $v) { empty($scope//VariableAccess[@Name = $v/@Name]) } return ( //MethodCall[ArgumentList/@Size = 1][ArgumentList/VariableAccess][not(*[1][self::ArgumentList])] [let $prop := lower-case(if (matches(@MethodName, '^set[A-Z]')) then substring(@MethodName, 4) else @MethodName), $arg := ArgumentList/VariableAccess/@Name, $scope := $scopeOf(.) return exists($scope[not(ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'Override'])]) and string-length($prop) >= 4 and lower-case($arg) != $prop and exists($scope//VariableId[lower-case(@Name) = $prop][parent::FormalParameter[parent::FormalParameters/parent::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration]] or parent::VariableDeclarator/parent::LocalVariableDeclaration[not(ancestor::LambdaExpression)]] [$unread($scope, .)])] | //MethodCall[ArgumentList/@Size >= 3] [let $names := ArgumentList/VariableAccess/@Name, $scope := $scopeOf(.) return exists($scope) and count($names) = ArgumentList/@Size and (some $x in distinct-values($names) satisfies matches($x, '[A-Za-z_][0-9]+$') and count($names[. = $x]) = 2 and (let $base := replace($x, '[0-9]+$', '') return exists($scope//VariableId[replace(@Name, '[0-9]+$', '') = $base][matches(@Name, '[0-9]+$')] [not(@Name = $names)][$unread($scope, .)])))] )
